transcript.text: This is Swift, an automated flood assistant working with local emergency services. Am I speaking with someone at 160 Loch Maree Lane?
Yes, this is 160 Loch Maree Lane. We have four people here, including my husband who needs oxygen and can’t leave alone. We’re not in water, but we can’t get help with a truck, boat, or seats.
Thank you for confirming your address and needs. How many people are at the home right now, including anyone who can't come to the phone?
Four people total. My husband can’t leave alone—he’s on oxygen.

I heard you have four people at home. Is there anyone there who can't leave on their own, for example someone who uses a wheelchair, needs oxygen, or is bedbound? If it's a wheelchair, does it have a motor?
Yes, my husband can’t leave alone. He needs oxygen.
I heard you said your husband needs oxygen and can’t leave alone. Is there water inside the home right now?
No water inside. Husband needs oxygen and can’t leave alone.
I hear you’re caring for your husband right now. If neighbors need a ride out, do you have a high-clearance truck, a boat, or free seats in a vehicle?
No truck, no boat, no free seats. Can’t help with rides right now.
Understood, no truck, boat, or free seats right now. Let me read that back: 4 people; husband needs help leaving because of oxygen; no water inside yet. Is that right?
Yes. Four people. Husband needs oxygen and can’t leave alone. No water inside.

Got it, thank you for confirming. I've recorded that you need help leaving. No responder has been assigned yet. If water is rising inside, move to the highest floor and call 911 if you can get through. Goodbye.

house_card: Four people. Husband needs oxygen and can't leave alone. No water inside. English language.
